name: k8s node memory — a cluster node's working set above 90% of capacity
description: Fires, per k8s.node.name, when MAX(working_set / (working_set + memory.available)) from the kubelet over the trailing 10 min exceeds 0.90 — kubelet's own eviction signal, ahead of the MemoryPressure condition. Emitter: one kubeletstats per node on the poweredge-xubuntu collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml). Runbook: open the 'Kubernetes node load' board; ssh <node>; mpstat 5 3; free -g; kubectl describe node <node>; kubectl get pods -A -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=<node>. Plan kubernetes-node-observability (livespec-dev-tooling-dfdiil), item livespec-dev-tooling-uftb4o.
